Make Mac computer-control feedback consistently visible for pointer, accessibility, and keyboard actions. The Bot cursor appears above menus and briefly marks the last action without delaying execution or retaining control. Stop, permission loss, and disconnect still clear it immediately.

Replace the Mac menu-bar icon with a dedicated 18-point SVG template, keeping it crisp at menu-bar sizes.

Reduce copying while receiving large screenshot replies. A synthetic 8 MiB reply benchmark improved from approximately 33 ms to 12 ms; this measures reply handling, not screen capture or complete agent turns.

Includes mobius 0.15.41 and the signed, notarized Mac app 0.15.42. No architecture, gateway protocol, or storage-schema changes.
